lines.name: Academy
lines.description: ATTENTION STUDENTS AND FACULTY: It has come to our attention that all students are currently facing disiplinary action and all professors are on "suggested" psychiatric leave. Class will be canceled until further notice, perhaps a time when the aformentioned suspeded students have reexamined their abysmal behavior.

lines.name: Aegis Frame
lines.description: Caught in the thrall of a dying black hole, one world looks to a neighboring galaxy for sanctuary. To navigate the harsh, uncharted depths of space, they send colossal mechs capable of surviving such a journey to find a new home. When none return, a second mission is mounted, both to carve a new foothold and discover what dangers might await.

lines.name: Albion
lines.description: Once the dominion of fallen Elven empires, the vast forests of Albion are now home to kingdoms and brigands and elves and free men in equal measure. There's power to be found in the imperial ruins, should anyone be bold enough to venture deep into the woods to seek it…

lines.name: Arcade: Battle Bosses
lines.description: Deep within Arcadia's servers lies a sinister series of glitches known to all gamers as the Battle Bosses. Their corrupted code has brought them newfound freedom… but also new challengers. To complete their deletion of the Arcade World, many of the Bosses have agreed to put aside their differences (until it's… inconvenient).

lines.name: Arcade: Heroes
lines.description: Arcadia: home to the server's most competitive arcade gamers and justice-driven NPCs. Here, the heroes always play to win. And that means overriding the Battle Bosses' corrupted code, even with the odds stacked against them. Victory won't come easy, but seeing the surprise on the bosses' faces after an incredible outplay will totally make it worth it.

lines.name: Arcanists
lines.description: Right outside the academy doors is a world filled with magic... and danger. The professors caution the young wizards and witches to stay within the safety of the school grounds, grow their power, and study well—but where is the fun in that when adventure awaits just beyond the bend?

lines.name: Arclight
lines.description: Once each millenium an ancient, godlike entity descends from the heavens, choosing worthy warriors to be his will incarnate. These beings are the Arclight—immortal agents of the light divine.

lines.name: arcticops
lines.description: High Command needed a new group to handle the growing threats along the Arctic Front. They needed soldiers colder than the glaciers they'd be crossing, with ice in their veins and frosty nerves. Enter Arctic Ops.

lines.name: Ashen Knights
lines.description: Many ages long past, a great king waged a glorious war: to break the shackles of magic on the world, so that mankind could forge its own destiny. Yet upon severing the final font of enchantment, the king was lost, the foundations of the world crumbled, and his once-legendary knights were left alone to madness, ruin, and ash.

lines.name: Astronauts
lines.description: Astronauts, hijinks, and adorable alien meeps! Defying gravity is just another day for these adventurous space protectors, as they defend planet M33p and traverse the grand cosmos that awaits them.

lines.name: Battle Academia
lines.description: At these institutions, only the strong survive. Though they were founded to honor their God Weapon, the students at each academy strive to make its strength their own on their path to glory. Whether it's the classroom, or the battlefield, dominate the competition.

lines.name: Battle of the God-Kings
lines.description: At the end of a dark timeline, two kings descended from the primordial gods of Order and Chaos lead vast armies in one final clash.

lines.name: Bees!
lines.description: Bzzz. Bzzz bzzz bzzz. Bzzz! Bzzz, bzz, bzz bzz bzz. Bzzz...

lines.name: Beta
lines.description: Who let these stay in the build???? Don't tell Legal.

lines.name: Bewitching
lines.description: Who said witches can't have fun? Whoever it was, they're probably a frog now. Or some other cursed vermin, doomed to forever wander the streets, watching the eve's celebrations from afar. Pretty harsh punishment, but what did you expect? They may know how to throw a party, but at the end of the night, they're still witches!

lines.name: Bilgewater: Burning Tides
lines.description: Welcome to Bilgewater, where fortunes're made at the end of a gun. Anything y'might need can be found at the slaughter docks, whether that be some hired hands, sea monster stew, or the captain who will send you to your watery grave.

lines.name: Bilgewater: Curse of the Drowned
lines.description: 'Neath waxing moon and rising tides, dark magicks stir and secrets hide. Where salt and blood and fell winds flow… as above the waves, so too below.

lines.name: Bilgewater: Mercs
lines.description: Bounty hunters, outlaws, and pirates alike swarm to Bilgewater's infamous slaughter docks like flies to butcher's trimmings. It's a hard life on these seas, but the reward can be well worth it... Bearded Lady permiting.

lines.name: Black Rose Group
lines.description: A psychic paramilitary unit of fearsome power, the Black Rose Group hopes to create a new global order with their ferocious human bioweapons.

lines.name: Blackfrost
lines.description: The Ice Witch lets none slumber; each fallen friend and foe in her domain rises anew to fight by her side. Her dark magic twists their appearance, creating glacial golems with hearts of black, unmelting ice.

lines.name: Blood Moon
lines.description: An ancient cult, seeking irresistible power, surfaces on nights of the Blood Moon to perform profane, esoteric rites—merging their flesh with demonic spirits, and becoming one with an ever greater darkness.

lines.name: Bloodstone
lines.description: Terrors abound in the depths of night, with none as fearsome as the Bloodstone cults. Shrieks fill the air in their presence, while the streets run red, for their master hungers and must be satiated.

lines.name: Broken Covenant
lines.description: For years the Aspirant congregation has fought the Neverghaast sect over Aspira, the breath of life. To the congregation, Aspira is a gift one returns upon death to enter the afterlife. But the Neverghaast, cursed with an eternal thirst for breaths, believe there is only one life and it must be lived to excess. The war rages on, with no end in sight...

lines.name: Cats Versus Dogs
lines.description: The oldest rivalry the world has ever known: man's best friend pitted against the internet's greatest heroes. Only one faction will emerge victorious from the gnawing maw of battle between cats and dogs. Hopefully they don't get their fur too dirty: the only thing worse than losing is bathtime.

lines.name: Challenger
lines.description: Commemorating the annual League of Legends season start.

lines.name: Chosen of the Wolf
lines.description: When the young warleader Ambessa falls in battle, she is granted a vision of Volrachnun, a hallowed afterlife for worthy followers of the Wolf. All who are welcomed into this haven must join the Eternal Chase, finding bliss in battle and joyfully challenging their fellow chosen warriors in a never-ending hunt.

lines.name: Chronicle
lines.description: Legends are tested, shaped, and forged by their pasts.

lines.name: Classic
lines.description: The elders of our world speak in hushed tones of a mystical land that once was. This hallowed place teemed with ancient sorcerers known as "summoners" who would war with one another night and day. Only at the battle's end would they utter the hallowed words of "gg" before departing to revel in their hard-earned runes and quintessences, whatever they are.

lines.name: Collector's Edition
lines.description: Everything feels better when it comes inside a Collector's Edition box, be it digital or physical.

lines.name: Commando
lines.description: Just your average bottomless pit of scum and villainy. Bosses vie for power; pacts are made and broken; friendships meet their end on the edge of twisted, subtle knives. And yet, there's something more to this city. Something undiscovered, imperceptible. Something... infinite.

lines.name: Conqueror
lines.description: Commemorating the League of Legends Mid-Season Invitational and Spring Split tournaments.

lines.name: Cops and Robbers
lines.description: Nobody puts in the work like the Piltover Police Department. Who else can lock up the most sugar-laden donuts inside their merciless stomachs, rack up the highest of overtimes, and ignore even the most menial of paperwork? The criminals may be taking advantage of it, but even they wish they had the same work ethic.

lines.name: Cosmic
lines.description: Vast stardust creatures control the ebb and flow of creation, painting the cosmos with sublime light as their celestial court drifts along the fabric of time and space.

lines.name: Cottontail
lines.description: It's rabbit season! Fine folk up and down the bunny trail are dressed in their bun-day best, eggs painted and smiles wide. Here's hoping their hopping helps you with holiday cheer!

lines.name: Coven
lines.description: The witches lay in wait, a sisterhood of frightening pulchritude, their hopes whispered forth from desacralized lips. They speak of the bloating corpses of Old Gods, of ancient rites carried out with magics long forgotten to mortal mind, of the return of what they call "order", but others call "suffering". Hark! Mankind's end fast approaches.

lines.name: Crime City
lines.description: Valoran City, a sprawling machine fueled by crime and oiled by sordid money. No one admits this truth, but everyone knows it.

lines.name: Crime City Nightmare
lines.description: If corruption and illegality existed on a map, Valoran City would be its center. A breeding ground for all things depraved, there are no depths too deep from which evil can be found, and the horrors that lurk there are eager to spread their influence.

lines.name: Crimson Elite
lines.description: We can neither confirm nor deny the Crimson Elite's involvement in any criminal activities and request all inquiries be directed to local authorities.

lines.name: Crystal Rose
lines.description: Romance and joy are in the air at the yearly Crystal Rose Festival, where adversaries meet on peaceful, neutral ground to share a night of dancing, merriment, and making wishes for the future. Everyone is expected to leave their weapons at the door as a promise for a better tomorrow.

lines.name: Crystalis Indomitus
lines.description: When the Prismae appeared, there were those that learned to hone their magic. But far to the north, the crystals' influence corrupts the very earth itself. Between the fractal undergrowth and iridescent air, creatures join forces with once-human inhabitants in a war against what remains of civilization. Everything will be reflected in the Prismae's image.

lines.name: Crystalis Motus
lines.description: Motus was a world bound to magic, but after the purge, everything collapsed. Centuries later, civilization is scattered, nature has reclaimed the cities, and magic's back in the form of Prismae Crystals. All it wants is to spread, and while some can use its power safely, others lose themselves to its pull and are taken over. So begins the Prismae Wars.

lines.name: Curse of the Void
lines.description: Should the scourge of the Void spread across Runeterra, all will bow to its twisted evolution. Swarming, hungering, wanting, the Void spares no creature and suffers no defeat.

lines.name: Cyber Pop
lines.description: In the vibrant underground of Sound City, hackers, skaters, rebels, and rogues band together away from the prying eyes of powerful cyber-corporate overlords.

lines.name: Dark Star
lines.description: Entropy engulfs galaxies in the yawning maw of the Dark Star, whose corruptants, titanic creatures of black-hole oblivion, snuff out the light of existence in every system they touch and plunge them into nothingness.

lines.name: Day Job
lines.description: It's a living!

lines.name: Death Blossom
lines.description: The sylvan creatures of the northern forests lie dormant, unseen by weary traveler and brave warrior alike. These foul things wait for the perfect moment to strike, an exercise in patience passed only by creatures as ancient as the land itself, the prize a feast of flesh and bone that bathes the soil in dark, rich crimson.

lines.name: Death Sworn
lines.description: Eager to claim more souls for the underworld, Death sends the souls of fallen warriors as Death Sworn back to the mortal plane, where they serve their master's terrible bidding with relish.

lines.name: Debonair
lines.description: Power, wealth, and glamour collide in the penthouses and exclusive clubs of Nox Vegas, where truly beautiful people hold the world in their palms. Yet as night falls on the city of lights, the knives come out—influence is the name of the game, and nobody likes to lose.

lines.name: Definitely Not
lines.description: Is that a robot in glasses and a trenchcoat? Of course not. Do your eyes perceive a beast man in a onesie? Better get those eyes checked, because they're wrong. Isn't Draven too modest to wear his own head? How foolish you must feel to even ask. And that laser squid? Definitely human. Definitely.

lines.name: Demacia Vice
lines.description: As Ahri locks in her character on the start screen, the synth-heavy score fills the arcade. Her button taps aren't random, but perfectly calculated as she guides her champ through the crime-filled Demacian streets. A crowd gathers, intent on watching Ahri finally beat the high score, set by her only days ago.

lines.name: Demonic
lines.description: Even in the kingdom of Hell, fervent personalities jockey for higher standing, gambling with the souls of mortals in their power plays for the dark lord's favor.

lines.name: DJ
lines.description: Feel the bass. Hear the beat. Let the music move you.

lines.name: Dragon World
lines.description: Twice did dragonfire consume the world. Twice from the embers were heroes forged.

lines.name: Dragonmancers
lines.description: Majestic dragons dwell in remote places of wild beauty, avoiding mortal affairs outside of rarely bestowing their gifts on only a select few. The Dragonmancers are those fortunate and powerful enough to have gained the ultimate blessing. Whether they then use that for good or for evil is up to them, and anyone strong enough to stop them.

lines.name: Dreadknights
lines.description: Brought back to life by mysterious ancient magic, these undead knights are the only remnants of a storied history, lost to time. They'll protect what once was theirs, at any cost to mortal life.

lines.name: Dreadnova
lines.description: A criminal network of ruthless mercenaries who rule entire swaths of the galaxy, Dreadnova has grown powerful since its founders fled Genesis Industries' ranks with stolen exosuit plans in tow. Now they push back against the Royal Space Military's efforts to impose Genesis' corporate order, bringing to bear all the firepower the black market has to offer.

lines.name: Dumpling Darlings
lines.description: Any pastry mage worth their salt knows no get-together is complete without savory treats. Though their cafe may be new, the art of making dumplings isn't—and these magical chefs are willing to knead, chop, fry, and steam their way to culinary greatness. Just one bite of these doughy delights will make even the grumpiest patron eager to pull up a chair and celebrate.

lines.name: Dunkmaster
lines.description: There are two types of people in this world: those that dunk, and those who get dunked. If you don't know which one you are, then watch out! 'Cuz you're about to GET DUNKED!

lines.name: Eclipse
lines.description: Long ago, an order of monastic knights slew the vile gods of the old world, using esoteric powers granted by the moon and sun. Now the world has grown dark and violent, as those selfsame deities prepare their return—challenged only by the light of the eclipse.

lines.name: Elderwood
lines.description: Deep within the Elderwood, ancient beings lie in wait, hidden from man. They protect the enchanted forest, punishing trespassers and inspiring tales across the land. However, as horrors of the outside world spread, the defenders struggle to maintain their strongholds against humanity's malicious curiosity.

lines.name: Elementalist
lines.description: A kingdom hangs on the edge of ruin as an army of titanic elemental beasts wage war on humanity. The last line of defense is held by a lone warrior queen, Elementalist Lux. To save her people, she must look within and reveal her true nature... no matter what form it takes.

lines.name: Empyrean
lines.description: The first Empyrean, Pyke, tears through the realms on a destructive rampage against his counterparts, birthing new Empyreans in the process. Who will reign supreme as these new powerhouses emerge, and what will they do with their rapidly dwindling time left?

lines.name: Eternum
lines.description: In the hollow space between far-off stars, organic machines made by an unknown civilization have long since outlived their creators. They patiently lurk, unable to escape their terrestrial prison until someone stumbles upon them once more and unleashes them back out into the galaxy. They have waited. They are waiting. They will wait—as long as it takes.

lines.name: Fables
lines.description: Every culture has their own folklore surrounding legends and monsters. Are these myths a figment of our imagination, stories passed down through generations to explain the unexplainable? Or are they based in a truth hidden from the rest of the world?

lines.name: Faerie Court
lines.description: All fae nobility are servants to nature's will, carrying out the natural order and the turning of seasons with their magic. Beneath that higher purpose, however, a constant game of political intrigue plays out in luxurious courts of silk, gossamer, and gold. Power, after all—magical, natural, or political—always inspires competition.

lines.name: Fatemakers and Fatebreakers
lines.description: In a world entwined with the Weave of Fate, no thread is beyond reach for those bold enough to seize it. To do so, they must seek the Palace of the Weave and confront the Fatemakers, powerful entities entrusted with the warp and weft of destiny. Those who prove themselves—called Fatebreakers—can rewrite their fortunes... and the shape of things to come.

lines.name: Fist Bumps and Festivities
lines.description: Time to celebrate!

lines.name: Flora Fatalis
lines.description: The Flora Fatalis judges all who venture within its intoxicating reach, beckoning to those with nerve and ambition, luring them close enough to plant the potent seed of its will. Together they adapt and evolve, seeking ever-stronger hosts to empower—and to consume.

lines.name: Food Fight
lines.description: Both mouthwatering and foe slaughtering, these foods aren't going down without a fight.

lines.name: Forgotten Depths
lines.description: Sit down, my child, and listen close. The ocean is a wonder, the foaming waves that reach our peaceful shores a deceitful invitation. For what lies beneath that endless blue is a world beyond our imagining. Of kingdoms ruined and monsters fierce, floating down in those forgotten depths.

lines.name: Freljord
lines.description: The harsh, frozen north rarely sees travelers from other lands. Those that brave its wilds are met with hostile nature and unwelcoming hordes. Lucky are the few that survive to return to the nation they call home.

lines.name: Fright Night
lines.description: Bounding across the land on gargantuan frog legs, the Toadstool Boarding House attracts lodgers of the most frightful variety. Regardless of where it settles, there is always a monster in need of a place to stay, and Mother Glasc is always there to welcome them into the family with open arms. And an endless labyrinth of rooms ensures that none are ever turned away.

lines.name: Galactic
lines.description: The War of the Broken Moon has ravaged our galaxy for near a hundred cycles. And still... there is no end in sight.

lines.name: Glacial
lines.description: The world is frozen, with few left to remember its cause. Old terrors stir from beneath the ice, ready to claim the world once more. The flame of hope remains, but the days are short, and the nights long…

lines.name: Goth
lines.description: It's not a phase.

lines.name: Grand Reckoning
lines.description: It is Noxian tradition to celebrate a great victory, and the triumph of strength over weakness. After their successful campaign into Freljordian territory, a Grand Reckoning is held in celebration of the returning General Darius and his warbands—drawing crowds to every arena in the capital to honor him, and all the renowned Reckoners of years past.

lines.name: Guardian of the Sands
lines.description: Powerful guardians stand watch over the tomb of an ancient horror, so that it may never threaten the world again. But they may already be too late...

lines.name: Headhunter
lines.description: For some species, the hunt is more than mere sport—it possesses their minds and bodies, molding them into a race of perfect killing machines.

lines.name: Heartbreakers
lines.description: Most seek out sweethearts in quiet parks or friendly tea shops. But those relationships never last. The bonds formed on the battlefield, piercing like bullets straight through the hearts of enemies... those endure.

lines.name: Heartsong
lines.description: There's a song that connects us all. It's hidden deep within, sleeping until we choose to wake it. Close your eyes and listen. Hear that? That's the magic in your heart, the sound of your soul!

lines.name: HEARTSTEEL
lines.description:
“HEARTSTEEL is the hottest new band on the scene, featuring artists like Kayn and Ezreal—”
“It's all of our band!”
“Calm down, Sett.”
“Wait, which magazine is this for again, K'Sante?”
“Please try to focus!”
“Hey Yone, can we just get on stage already?”
“We are—oh, well, Aphelios just walked off…”

lines.name: Heartthrobs and Heartaches
lines.description: The preppy and perfectly poised Heartthrob clique don't have much in common with the Heartache crew, who would much rather be ditching class to hang out at the skatepark. But they agree on one thing: they've had it with this silly made up holiday dedicated to people catching feelings. So why can't they seem to shake the butterflies from their stomachs?

lines.name: Heavenscale
lines.description: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

lines.name: Heavy Metal
lines.description: Audiences gather from all over the world for a chance to witness the greatest robot fighters throw down in RiotCorp's gladiatorial arenas, eager for the chance to be crowned the Full Metal Robot Fighting League Champion or break down trying.

lines.name: Hextech
lines.description: Now at the forefront of science and art, Hextech has evolved from its rudimentary beginnings into a modern renaissance of intricate, artificial lifeforms capable of free will. Skilled artificers lead the medium into a bold new future -- but what it will bring, none can say.

lines.name: High Noon
lines.description: Gunslingers and lawmen ride beneath the merciless sun of the high frontier, chasing survival and salvation in equal measure. Heaven is rubble, hell is empty, and all the devils are here.

lines.name: High Society
lines.description: The only thing more impressive than their wealth is their tax avoidance skills.

lines.name: Highstakes
lines.description:
Once, there were five, a strange group indeed,
\nThat made up the court of High Stakes.
\nThey bickered and fought, had luck and had not,
\nTo this day, no one yet knows their fate.

lines.name: Immortal Journey
lines.description: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

lines.name: Infernal
lines.description: Scorching an entire world takes unimaginable strength, which is why the Ashen Lord called upon his legions of Infernals to lend their flames. From the darkest depths, they each bring their own terrible powers to bear, though not all answer their call with the same burning enthusiasm.

lines.name: Inkshadow
lines.description: On the outskirts of Rabadon City, a dilapidated temple houses the last hope for Rabadon's people: the Inkshadow Warriors. Each one sacrifices what is most important to them in order to make a contract with ancient spirits, who imbue them with magic tattoos so powerful, even the Cabal trembles. They are victims no more. It is time to take back their home.

lines.name: Invaders
lines.description: True to their title, these nefarious alien meeps have stumbled upon a power they don't quite understand. Unfortunately, misery loves company. Those who come into contact with the invaders almost always come out on the other side just a little more evil… and purple!

lines.name: Justicar
lines.description: Standing tall within the Agents of Light are the Justicars, sentinels of the Arclight exemplifying its strongest virtues. It is not enough to serve as an example for only mortals, for even divine soldiers need inspiration.

lines.name: K/DA
lines.description: “There is a place between fantasy and reality where anything can happen. You have the power to be anyone, and do anything. It is your dream. In our in-between world, K/DA feels confident and strong. We can do anything, and so can you.” -Kai'Sa

lines.name: Kaiju
lines.description: From the depths of the planet, they rise: colossal entities of horror and hunger, mightier than armies and mountains. Their motivations are uncertain; their designs, unknown. The one thing that is clear is that we will not survive them... unless we create the means to stop them.

lines.name: La Ilusión
lines.description: The Eidola Vida were once mortal but, upon death, were reborn as spirits of life from their families' love. The Eidola Muerte were forgotten souls who, in death, roamed the afterlife until they found their own makeshift families. Both sides cannot be seen, only felt through their Ardor: magical flames that either help cultivate life or extinguish it.

lines.name: Lancer
lines.description: With the times growing dire, the great mechanized Lancers of old rouse from their slumber. Taller than any building and more powerful than any army, they rise to protect their subjects before returning to the earth once more.

lines.name: Legacy
lines.description: Treasures from days long passed, glimmering just within reach.

lines.name: Luchador
lines.description: From the top rope comes the greatest show in sports entertainment! Watch as El Tigre, El Macho, El León, and El Rayo trade bumps and high-flying spots inside AND outside the squared circle. Just remember, nobody does it better than the Wrestling Federation of Valoran.

lines.name: Lunar Beast
lines.description: Each year, a mischievous Lunar Beast arrives in the mortal realm, drawn to the New Year's celebrations. And each year, the corresponding Lunar God selects a squad of chosen champions to lead the beast on a merry chase and protect the city from the creature's playful rampage. The Lunar Parade is a beloved part of the New Year's festivities and the Beast itself brings good luck once it's been lulled to rest by the squad's efforts. When a Lunar Beast is well-entertained and well-rested, it always signals a prosperous New Year!

lines.name: Lunar Revel
lines.description: Join with friends and frenemies alike and celebrate the stories of the past year. Glowing lanterns touch the night sky, lit by fading fireworks. Red envelopes trade hands, families and clans that rarely meet rejoice in a shared acknowledgement: a new year beckons. May it be your best one yet!

lines.name: Lunar Revel: Firecracker
lines.description: The Lunar New Year has arrived—and so has the party! With food and festivities to spare, it's all about ringing it in with friends and family. Now strike up a match and watch the fireworks!

lines.name: Lunar Revel: Warring Kingdoms
lines.description: Three great empires vie for land and power, bringing their all to bear in a test of martial might. Armies will clash. Heroes will rise. Legends will be made.

lines.name: Mad Scientists
lines.description: The job requirements are pretty simple: we're looking for at least five years of experience in applied sciences, your last peer-reviewed paper, and two references. Oh, and an evil laugh. Actually, put that at the top of the list.

lines.name: Magma Chamber
lines.description: For years, the people of the Forgotten Lands whispered of the vaunted Magma Chamber, a promised place hidden deep below that would rise up and change the world forever. Finally, its great walls have fractured, freeing the dark and slightly odd secrets within...

lines.name: Marauder
lines.description: A horde of nomadic warriors with a taste for brutality, the Marauders are all that remain of Magelord warrior culture, their ancient traditions abandoned in favor of anarchic shows of force. No dispute is settled until blood is spilled, even within their own ranks. They lost sight of what led their ancestors to war in the first place and what ultimately led to their victory.

lines.name: Masked Justice
lines.description: After destroying its own homeworld, the mad giant Mezzorax searched the galaxy until it found a new planet to invade: the bustling metropolis of Ocono. But now an unlikely group of citizens is fighting back. Empowered by alien Hyperguise suits, they will avenge the lives Mezzorax has stolen and end his reign for good.

lines.name: Masque of the Black Rose
lines.description: Revelry and luxury reign at the Silken Danse, a masquerade uniting nobles and luminaries from across Runeterra. But in Noxus, the ballroom is a battlefield. A whisper is as sharp as a dagger, and power is traded between pleasantries. Even the reclusive Lady Elise has left her nest to host the event, in service to unseen eyes… Watching. Waiting.

lines.name: Mecha
lines.description: When colossal kaiju begin attacking from the sea, land, and air, humanity develops equally powerful mecha units to stop them in explosive hand-to-hand combat.

lines.name: Mecha Kingdoms
lines.description: The Great Kingdoms warred for generations until the arrival of a new enemy. To fight back, they are blessed with gifts from the heavens. Will they rise above their past to save their future?

lines.name: Medieval
lines.description: Hark, ye knights and knaves, for these lands are under the royal protection of the King and Queen! Make way, make way!

lines.name: Modern Mythos
lines.description: Myths and legends happened long ago, but their echoes are still felt to this day. Beneath the surface of the mundane world, mythical power uplifts a new generation of heroes.

lines.name: Monster Tamers
lines.description: Who are we? We're Monster Tamers! We protect the world when it's in danger! When others would flee, we follow the roar. We tame the monster and use the CORE. And with our new friends by our side, we'll hop and run and swim and glide! We'll go anywhere, no matter how far. Because we're Monster Tamers! That's who we are!

lines.name: Mythmaker
lines.description: Long ago, the defeat of the Great Beast Galio gave rise to Lunar New Year traditions that are carried on through the retelling of that epic tale. Within the story itself lies a living world all its own—but when the world of the story is suddenly interrupted, the characters must work together to fix the mess and see their own myth through.

lines.name: Nightbringer and Dawnbringer
lines.description: Timeless is the conflict between the Nightbringers and Dawnbringers. On one side, the forces of chaos and darkness bring change, while on the other, the forces of order and light bring structure. It is these gods and their descendents that shape a nascent world, and who can say whether the future will yield brighter days... or darker nights.

lines.name: Ocean Song
lines.description: Nothing exudes the "beach vibes and cool tunes" lifestyle more than the Ocean Song Festival. From Seraphine's mellow songs to Yone's experimental DJ set, there's a vibe for everyone, so feel the sand between your toes, taste the salty air, and lose yourself to the best music of the summer.

lines.name: Odyssey
lines.description: From the urbanized coreworlds to the outermost edge of the galaxy, adventure awaits! The great Demaxian Empire ignores the objections of the Templar Order and the criminal Syndicate alike in their pursuit of ora—a mysterious golden essence that serves as the lifeblood of all civilization, and promises untold power to those who can wield it for themselves…

lines.name: Omega Squad
lines.description: When the war came, Omega Squad was sent to end it. Now only one of them remains, a yordle with no battles left to fight but his own...

lines.name: Omen of the Dark
lines.description: This story of a cursed queen and the wretched followers of her order makes unpleasant bedside banter for parents and their children. But lessons last longer when the tale is gripped in shadow, which swirls in dreams and shapes the souls of impressionable youth. The nightmares are just nightmares, after all... or so the adults pray.

lines.name: Order of the Lotus
lines.description: Esteemed leaders and devoted acolytes in the Order of the Lotus are the finest of the First Lands. Avatars of immortality and virtue, members of the Order live many lifetimes, striving to keep peace eternal.

lines.name: Otherroads
lines.description: A featherknight flaps its wings, and halfway across Runeterra, an Ocean Drake surfaces. Our lives play out, fickle as words on parchment; the paths before us unknown and exciting. What if the road taken instead... was the one less traveled?

lines.name: Pandemonium
lines.description: Through a demon's eyes, emotions blaze in colors only they can see. In this hidden spectrum, every soul is laid bare. When emotions surge beyond control, they flare like beacons, drawing in demons... and the stronger the feeling, the stronger the pull.

lines.name: Papercraft
lines.description: Do you see a saddle on my back?" chirped the phoenix. "I am no pack-bird. And that yeti will weigh down our flight." The boy looked on, his perfect plan rejected. But then, a smile creased his face. After all, in this world of folded foliage and crinkled creeks, adventure is always just beyond the bend.

lines.name: PAX
lines.description: PAX: the intersection of all things gaming, where play is celebrated and immortal bonds are formed.

lines.name: Pentakill
lines.description: In a world where heavy metal reigns supreme, PENTAKILL are the undisputed masters of melting the face right off your head. Six members, two penta-platinum albums, and the chrome-fisted fury of the gods themselves. It's time to rock!

lines.name: Pentakill III: The Lost Chapter
lines.description: In a realm consecrated to dark and uncaring gods, where mortals clash in ceaseless, bloody sagas of metal, one band rose above all others: Pentakill, chosen of the Noisome Host. Now revered in temples and arenas across the land, their supremacy has become absolute—though a time of change is approaching, and the cycle may soon begin anew...

lines.name: Petals of Spring
lines.description: Deep within the spirit realm lies a garden of myth, where each plant embodies mortal hopes, dreams, and suffering. Gardeners tend to it with sacred care, pruning sorrow and nurturing new blossoms. If all goes well, the Frostpyre flowers bloom—signaling the coming melt of snow—and Spring returns, bringing life back to both the garden and the mortal world.

lines.name: Pharaoh
lines.description: Though their empires were swallowed by the sands, mighty Pharaohs once ruled the sun-baked dunes of the Great Desert.

lines.name: Phoenixmancers
lines.description: Only the truest hearts are blessed by the divine fenghuang, a legendary phoenix who watches over the world. Her champions receive a single feather—each one containing unimaginable elemental power, granting them the means needed to protect all that is innocent and good from forces lurking in the shadows.

lines.name: Piltover Customs
lines.description: Looking for a souped-up ride? Look no further. (Mileage may vary.)

lines.name: Pool Party
lines.description: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

lines.name: Popstar
lines.description: When you're at the top of the charts, no one can bring you down.

lines.name: Porcelain
lines.description: In a world where ancient spirits and magical creatures thrive in the periphery of modern society, powerful porcelain artifacts called the Zodiac Relics are key to unlocking immense power. They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

lines.name: Praetorian
lines.description: Nothing is safe from the cold clutches of the Praetorians, a mechanical plague tearing through spacetime. For as hard as the Remembrancers fight to stave off the eradication of all life, deep down they are filled with fear, knowing that at some point they'll tire, while the Praetorians never will.

lines.name: Prehistoric Hunters
lines.description: Gargantuan monsters roam our land, stalking their prey with frightening precision. Humans would surely become their next meals, if not for the Hunters. Armed with blades crafted from the bones of their first kills, with instincts that rival the most fearsome of beasts, the Hunters protect their people each day from a grisly fate.

lines.name: Primal Ambush
lines.description: Those lucky enough to be born with glowing markings on their skin are revered among their people as “Favorclaw.” These special Tigrasbornes are destined to represent their community and demand the respect of others with their strength. They each hope to conquer the world in the name of their kind and become the leader feared by all.

lines.name: Primordian
lines.description: Cast from dry land, the Primordians bided their time deep beneath the sea, biding their time for centuries… until they could no longer abide the surface-dwellers any longer, nor their abuses of the planet. Thus the Primordian Queen's judgment was made: humanity's era in the sun is over, and that of the Primordians has only just begun.

lines.name: Program
lines.description: An advanced security algorithm created by the PROJECT Corporation, the Program quietly evolved sentience before altering its original directive. Infecting machines across The City, it has determined that the ultimate threat to humanity's safety... is humanity itself.

lines.name: PROJECT
lines.description: The PROJECT Corporation believes unlocking the secrets of humanity's potential is the key to progress beyond our mortal bodies. It is through technology that we will ascend. Together.

lines.name: PsyOps
lines.description: The crown jewel of military black ops, the PsyOps unit are an elite team of psychic soldiers deployed against rogue militaries and supernatural threats. Officially, they don't exist. But when conventional warfare won't cut it and the stakes are no less than the fate of the world, PsyOps answers the call.

lines.name: Pulsefire
lines.description: After unlocking the secrets of time travel, these champions are thrust into a far-flung dystopian future. While Chrono-enforcers relentlessly pursue them across time and space, a small few have escaped into history—taking their technology along for the ride.

lines.name: Rain Shepherd
lines.description: The world is parched, without water and song. Since the frogs lost the power to sing, rains have slowed and moisture is sparse. So frogs have taught a new group to sing: the Rain Shepherds. Clad in special rain gear, they work to replenish the lands and return nature to its formerly lush self.

lines.name: Revenant Reign
lines.description: The kingdom has fallen. The dead stir. The Underworld rises. All hail Rex Mortis, the newly-crowned king of death! May his glorious and terrible reign endure forevermore.

lines.name: Rift Hospital
lines.description: Take a seat. The doctor will be right with you.

lines.name: Rift Quest
lines.description: Danger lurks in the land of Runeterra! Powerful monsters, dastardly sorcerers, and mythical creatures roam unchecked! Gather your friends and create your own adventure for 3-5 players, vanquishing evil with each roll of the die. Do you have what it takes to save the world, and become a legend of RIFTQUEST?

lines.name: Riot
lines.description: In the criminal justice system, there are those who bend the law and those who break it. The dedicated officers at the RPD investigate the city's most heinous crimes to bring the worst offenders to justice. These are their stories...

lines.name: Risen Legends
lines.description: Long ago, gods of myth sealed their strength within the four Shards of the Risen: Chaos, Harmony, Patience, and Vigor. Each presented a life-threatening trial to warriors who sought its power, promising to immortalize them in history. To this day, fighters across the land rise to the challenge in hopes of leaving a legacy that even a god will respect.

lines.name: Road Warrior
lines.description: Out in the wasteland, the only gospel a Road Warrior needs is the hum of an engine, and the only prayers they hear are the curses of their enemies.

lines.name: Ruination
lines.description: One thousand years ago, the last king of Camavor chose to follow his heart at the expense of his country. So powerful was his love that fate intervened, and only ruin followed.

lines.name: Ruined
lines.description: The Harrowing spreads its Black Mist across Runeterra, corrupting indiscriminately. Some, in its presence, are swayed to follow the Ruined King, believing their goals aligned. But Viego wants only the return of Isolde; he has no allies. The Ruined who aid him in halting the Sentinels are mere pawns in a broken-hearted lover's game.

lines.name: Sentinels of Light
lines.description: Though their numbers are few, the Sentinels of Light share a storied history. For years they've fought back the Harrowing, aided by ancient relic-stone weaponry that channels their very souls into a powerful light. But all that matters now is the battle ahead, as the Ruined King lays waste to Runeterra, all to dance with his queen once more.

lines.name: Shan Hai Scrolls
lines.description: Within the fabled Shan Hai Scrolls, gods and mythical creatures roam magical lands, wielding the power of the elements. Some are content to live with the palette they've been given, while others wish to jump beyond the borders and paint their lives with a new brush.

lines.name: Shockblade
lines.description: Bearing weapons imbued with lightning magic through the deadly Cloud Ritual, Shockblades are an order of mysterious shinobi warriors tasked with protecting humankind from malevolent spirits and monsters. They travel between the mortal and spirit realms to chase down threats no one else can touch, safeguarding the future for all denizens of the mortal world.

lines.name: Silver Age
lines.description: The rift's greatest superheroes and most dastardly villains, available at a comic store near you!

lines.name: Sinful Shores
lines.description: When summer's heat climbs to infernal heights, demons rise from the underworld… for some fun in the sun! Trading in damnation for relaxation, they flock to the seashores eager to swim and soak in the sweltering rays. But mortals beware: when these fiends throw a beach bash, they're sure to raise hell.

lines.name: Snow Day
lines.description: It's beginning to look a lot like Snow Day, up and down the lanes... \nThough your tank may be rushing in, Top is backing again, \nThey have gold to spend on a Lich Bane...

lines.name: Snow Moon
lines.description: As the Snow Moon rises beyond the humbling mountains of Ionia, a chill passes across the land. Those who worship in its name—a cult of unwavering assassins—commence their ritual. With snow comes purification, a cleansing only possible through the sacrifice of one's humanity.

lines.name: Snowdown Showdown
lines.description: Better start building that snow fort...

lines.name: Soccer Cup
lines.description: Forget the battlefield, the boardroom, or even the playground: the most important conflicts of today are settled on the pitch. There is no act as satisfying as watching your favorite player slip through the other team, line up their shot, deliver that fateful kick, and release the sweetest word in existence: “GOOOOOAAAAALLLLL!”

lines.name: Soul Fighter
lines.description: Their souls awaken by trial: one fought on a battlefield or in the very trenches of the mind. Each is granted unique abilities reflective of their nature and the power to conjure forth the very essence of their spirit. Some hone their strength, temper it with training... Others will use it only as a weapon to destroy. They are... SOUL FIGHTERS!

lines.name: Soulstealer
lines.description: Souls are life, light, power—and in a world without mercy, they are stolen and consumed by remorseless masters of death.

lines.name: Space Groove
lines.description: In a groovy galaxy a million disco infernos away, a mysterious energy known only as The Groove brings music and prosperity to trillions of galactic citizens. But when the alien overlord Lissandra and her army of Harsh Vibes begin to enslave planets and suppress disco music, a new age of heroes rises to stop her, and keep the party grooving.

lines.name: Spirit Blossom
lines.description: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

lines.name: Spirit Blossom Springs
lines.description: High in the mountains lies a bathhouse where guests go to melt away their worldly cares. This themed retreat, called "Spirit Blossom Springs," is an oasis free of drama. Its welcoming staff and magical steam wash away the burdens of battle and memories best forgotten. There are no heroes or villains here—only the restful and the rejuvenated.

lines.name: Spirit Guard
lines.description: Udyr spent almost a decade training in Ionia with the monks of the Hirana Monastery, learning to control and master his spiritual abilities. At last, when the Freljord called him home, he chose to stay and complete his training. In the time since then, Udyr has become part of the Ionian landscape, both spiritual and mortal, as he works with Lee Sin and Karma to return balance to the wartorn land.

lines.name: Star Guardian Season 1
lines.description: Magically empowered by the First Star, high schooler Lux and her team of Star Guardians secretly protect the world from interstellar monsters. But who will protect them from the drama of Valoran City High?

lines.name: Star Guardian Season 2
lines.description: Veteran Star Guardians Ahri and Miss Fortune suddenly reappear in Valoran City, having rebuilt their team after an unknown event destroyed their previous squad. Seeking to defy the destiny of every Star Guardian who takes up the oath, they join the fight alongside Lux and company as Void Beasts descend upon the city.

lines.name: Star Guardian Season 3
lines.description: Ahri's old squad resurfaces, changed from the events that once tore them apart... and followed by a threat beyond anything the Star Guardians have ever faced. Can the group move past old grudges and save themselves from annihilation? Or will they simply be the next victims of the Twilight Star?

lines.name: Star Guardian Season 4
lines.description: Ancient enemies appear in a Valoran City scarred by Zoe's invasion, now defended by a new generation of Star Guardians. As darkness gathers in the skies above, Kai'Sa and Akali prepare their untested squad for a fight with forces beyond their comprehension... and the true threat that awaits beyond.

lines.name: Stargazer
lines.description: Adept diviners, the Stargazers have long unlocked and safeguarded the secrets of the cosmos within their order's vast library. Using esoteric knowledge and ancient powers, they have shielded their homesphere from countless threats. Yet few among them are prepared to confront an unknown terror emerging from another sphere—or even acknowledge its existence.

lines.name: Steel Legion
lines.description: In the shadow of all-out warfare between Genesis Industries and Dreadnova, ruined lives are just collateral damage. The Steel Legion is a vigilante organization operated out of run-down battleground planets, founded by refugees and armed by weapons crafted from scraps of rubble. If no one else will defend them, the people must defend themselves.

lines.name: Steel Valkyries
lines.description: A galaxy scarred by war now attempts to rebuild, but the old wounds remain. Criminals, bounty hunters, mercenaries, and assassins have filled the power vacuum, piloting dangerous combat exo-suits with godlike abilities.

lines.name: Storybook
lines.description: Once upon a time, there was a group of storybook characters brought to life from the page...

lines.name: Street Demons
lines.description: In Styxbridge City, demons, creatures, and humans live side-by-side. Every year, a street art festival is held, culminating in a friendly competition to see who can make the biggest and boldest graffiti: TagFest!

lines.name: Sugar Rush
lines.description: From the Gingerbread Castle to the Root Beer Sea, the Licorice Mountains to the Gumdrop Forest—this is the Candy Kingdom in all its glory.

lines.name: Sunken Shadows
lines.description: While feuding corsairs vie for dominion over the Umbral Seas, something far older stirs below. Few mortals who brave the depths return, and those who do are changed—haunted by whispers of witches and wraiths, relics and ruins from a world long forgotten by the tides.

lines.name: Super Galaxy
lines.description: Space, the most dangerous frontier! Only the Super Galaxy Defense Force, with its seemingly endless supply of fresh academy recruits, is prepared to explore the farthest uncharted worlds and defend from the most ruthless alien threats. Best gig in the galaxy!

lines.name: Superfans
lines.description: Let your fandom flag fly!

lines.name: Surprise Party
lines.description: Who doesn't like a surprise party? The guest list is done, everybody's bought their presents, and the food's going to be great. We even got a clown! This'll be one to remember. Just don't tell Amumu.

lines.name: The Eternal Aspects
lines.description: For millennia, the formidably powerful Aspects have worked tirelessly from the celestial realm to guide and strengthen Runeterra. Each one claims to be the ultimate manifestation of a universal truth of creation—indeed, they seek out mortal hosts worthy and capable of furthering their agendas, enabling them to walk the world in physical form once more.

lines.name: The Laws of Stone
lines.description: For almost a thousand years, Demacia has stood as a beacon of hope in a world so often darkened by sorcery and ruthless ambition. The foundation of this noble kingdom lies in the mystery of petricite—gleaming stone that can absorb even the most powerful magic—from mighty fortresses, to resplendent works of art that stir the soul of every proud citizen.

lines.name: Three Honors
lines.description: Society has become increasingly individualistic and closed off under the Essent's rule. People are encouraged to care only about themselves, so nobody trusts each other. As leader of the long-dead Order of Solace, Malzahar seeks to bring harmony to this dissonant world through the uplifting aura of Solace. He knows that only by coming together can they inspire a better world.

lines.name: Thunder Lord
lines.description: Mankind are not the only ones who fight bitter wars over petty squabbles. Once, before our time, two gods—two brothers—took up arms against each other, shaping the very land with the desolation of their battle.

lines.name: Toy Box
lines.description: Gnar's toy chest is brimming with priceless treasures, but when no one's home, his toys take on a life of their own...

lines.name: Traditional
lines.description: Honoring the initial designs of reworked champions.

lines.name: Trick-or-Treat
lines.description: You better hope you have the good stuff. You know, Piltover Pops, Strikebreaker Sours, Dark Star Chocolate Bars... 'Cause if you don't, the kids on this block have some tricks up their sleeves.

lines.name: Triumphant
lines.description: Awarded to players who won a League of Legends sponsored tournament.

lines.name: True Damage
lines.description: “What is True Damage? Man, True Damage is the future! It's a collective of the best artists from around the world, coming together with the best collaboration, to make the best hip-hop music. We're five steps ahead of the game. Everyone else has gotta catch up.” -Ekko

lines.name: Urf the Manatee
lines.description: In loving memory of Urf, a gentle sea cow warrior who now practices with his spatula in the shallow marshes of the great beyond. Good night, sweet prince.

lines.name: Vandal
lines.description: The Vandals loom large over the wasteland. They are a gang of violent thugs prone to mass destruction, brutal beatdowns, and wanton murder… but they sure have a good time doing it.

lines.name: Victorious
lines.description: Champions conquer their enemies and ascend to new heights, achieving their wildest dreams and showing off their hard-earned spoils to any and all who want to look upon true greatness.

lines.name: Visions of the Fallen
lines.description:
“Once, we were gods. Now, lost eternally in the disembodied darkness of our imprisonment, we dream of a thousand inevitable, bloody returns… and all mankind begging for our divine mercy once more.”
In an age lost to legend, this world belonged to the Darkin.
And the Darkin intend to take it back.

lines.name: Warden
lines.description: The Protectorate was an order dedicated to enforcing a rigid, unforgiving system of laws, in an attempt to slow the seemingly inevitable rise of the Magelords. Though the order itself was disbanded long ago, Wardens now don their armor as they lie in wait for the opportunity to strike against the descendants of their ancient enemy.

lines.name: Warhounds
lines.description: Across the moonlit wastelands, Warhound bikers howl at the skies, engines growling in reply. They hunt in packs for Quicksilver, liquid moonlight that fuels their chrome-plated machines and imbues them with monstrous power. When rival hunts collide, the desert erupts in claws and sparks—until only one pack lives to howl again.

lines.name: Winter Sports
lines.description: When the winter sports festival in question relaxed its rules, many assumed the event would become more exciting. But few realized just how dangerous it would become. Dangerously exciting that is!

lines.name: Winter Wonder
lines.description: Within the magical Winterlands, the Poro King reigns supreme, spreading joy and merriment to all of his court. Even as others work to usurp the king, all share a common love for winter's wonders.

lines.name: Winterblessed
lines.description: When the air grows crisp and the first snow falls, look to the sky, for Polaris will appear. Do not be afraid, for if you've been virtuous without expectation, you might be rewarded with the Aurora's blessings. But remember: no matter how you act, you cannot take your fortunes for granted, because Polaris comes every year, and no one escapes punishment.

lines.name: Withered Rose
lines.description: The Crystal Rose Festival welcomes all who believe in its dream of a peaceful tomorrow, though many have grown disenchanted with the whole affair. Those who make up the Withered Rose wish to see it come to an end. But no one is immune to the festival's charm; perhaps they too will be swept away by the evening's beauty and have a change of heart.

lines.name: Woad
lines.description: Few can survive a journey through the frozen tundra of the north. If the cold doesn't kill you... the Woad surely will.

lines.name: Wonders of the World
lines.description: Individuals hailing from the far-flung universe of "Earth," where giant statues come to life and everyone is wearing a fun hat. It's a lot like Runeterra, if you think about it.

lines.name: World Champions: 2011
lines.description: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2011: Fnatic!

lines.description: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2013: SK Telecom T1!

lines.description: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2014: Samsung White!
